C0512.title: Reverse Engineering API Encryption and Decryption Analysis
C0512.summary: An API encryption reverse-engineering example focused on an iOS app and Springboot backend interfaces, analyzing sign signatures and AES encryption mechanisms. The researcher used traffic capture, client-side reverse engineering, and interface parameter reconstruction to identify request signing and data encryption and decryption logic, illustrating that mobile app API encryption does not make interfaces impossible to analyze and still needs server-side risk control and authorization checks.
